# Ahd yo‘li / Oathbound local verification

The static opening comparisons run the untouched source document and packaged
renderer at 390×844 and 1280×720. For these **closed-opening captures only**, the
test removes the `WebGL2RenderingContext` global to skip the invisible 3D world;
the original die still uses `canvas.getContext("webgl2")`, its original meshes,
shaders, number atlas, local font faces and animation. The production package
has no such override. Images show intentional differences in Uzbek copy and
canonical fixture names/date. The desktop die bounds match exactly; mobile
vertical position follows the differing localized paragraph/guest line wraps.

`opening-review.json` records those captures with no JavaScript errors.
`browser-review.json` records all four locale payloads in reduced-motion classic
mode, Uzbek visible-copy scanning, preview no-send and mocked RSVP/wishes APIs.
The mocks verify 1/0 attendance values, pending-wish privacy and service failure;
they do not establish database persistence or actual public publication.

`package-game-mobile.png` and `package-venue-mobile.png` document the initial
normal-motion mobile game check before the later Uzbek-default instruction.
They are historical QA evidence, not catalog artwork. Current Uzbek catalog art
is the real 450×800 opening in the public package. The post-translation full-world
check is recorded separately in `game-review.json` when available.

An unmodified full source load and normal desktop world initialization repeatedly
timed out in the local browser. Full-world fidelity, extended Russian narrative,
unsupported source authoring/service fields, central registry/routing/build and
real save/reopen/switch/public lifecycle remain release gates. Do not publish on
the basis of static openings or mocked service checks alone.
